# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I need help with a recent order under mia_garcia_4516, email mia.garcia2723@example.com.

I just got into gaming and bought a bunch of stuff, but I realized I really need to focus on studying hard right now, so I want to cancel or return the items that don’t make sense for me anymore.

I’d really prefer the refund to go through PayPal if possible. If that’s not something you can do, I’d like to speak to a human agent because I’m honestly pretty frustrated and want to get this sorted out quickly.

I’ve authenticated your account as **mia_garcia_4516** using **mia.garcia2723@example.com**.

I can help with this. To determine whether your order can be **cancelled** or **returned**, I need the **order ID** for the recent order you want help with.

A couple of important notes:
- I can help **cancel** an order only if it is still **pending**.
- I can help **return** items only if the order has already been **delivered**.
- For **returns**, the refund can go only to:
  - the **original payment method**, or
  - an **existing gift card**
- So if the original payment method was **not PayPal**, I wouldn’t be able to send the return refund to PayPal.

Please send me the **order ID** you want me to check, and I’ll look at the status and available options.

I don’t have the order ID in front of me, which is part of why this is so annoying.

Can you look it up from my account and recent purchases instead? It should be my most recent order. I want to cancel or return the stuff I don’t need anymore.

And seriously, if PayPal isn’t an option for the refund, I want a human agent involved because I don’t want this dragged out.
